content.title: Houston Astros vs Athletics Live Stream: How to Watch MLB
content.text: The Athletics host the Astros on Sunday afternoon in the third and final game of their series The Athletics will look to clinch a series win on Sunday afternoon against the Houston Astros. The Athletics took the first game of the series 11-4, but couldn’t stop the Astros in the second game and lost 11-0 on Saturday. The loss on Saturday kept the Athletics from winning a second straight game for the first time this season. They have struggled to start the year and now sit at 2-6 overall, and they are in last place in the AL West. They are a game and a half back of the Seattle Mariners for fourth place. On Sunday, the Athletics will send Jacob Lopez to the mound. Lopez went four innings in his first start against the Atlanta Braves. He gave up six hits and three runs and would take the loss as the A’s failed to score in the game. The Astros will counter with Lance McCullers Jr. as they try to win a second straight game and clinch a series win over the division-rival A’s. McCullers Jr. was great in his first start of the season against the Boston Red Sox. He went seven innings and gave up just one run on four hits. He would pick up the win, as the Red Sox would get an 8-1 victory. The loss on Friday snapped a five-game winning streak, but the win on Saturday kept them from dropping a second straight game and pushed their record to 6-3 on the season.
